scope: Soft-wrap vertical cursor movement, compact full-area symbol panel, delete callout and one-step undo, shared keyboard height editor.

rootCause.verticalCursor: The previous extension resolver only recognized explicit newline rows. A paragraph with soft wraps therefore always produced zero vertical offset, although the long-space gesture entered cursor mode.
rootCause.fix: Reuse a TextKit UITextView to estimate wraps from proxy context, 17 pt system font and keyboard width minus 48 pt. Preserve preferred x and send the resulting UTF-16 offset to UITextDocumentProxy. The App sandbox uses the actual host UITextView geometry.

features.symbolPanel: No large external title. Panel fills KeyboardView.bounds; old header and globe footer are hidden. Only return, mode and category controls remain; nine emoji columns at 440 pt.
features.deleteCallout: White card with red trash prompt above the backspace key, shown only after entering the upward deletion gesture. Ordinary press/repeat shows no floating prompt. Sliding back or cancelling disarms deletion without a stray backspace.
features.deleteUndo: One in-memory deletion record, checked against document identity and before/after/selection context. Button appears left of kana mode. New input, navigation, external change or leaving the keyboard clears it.
features.heightEditor: Main App offers a real keyboard preview with a draggable upper grip, save/cancel and reset. Scale range 0.85 to 1.60 affects key height and row spacing. App Group shares the value with the extension, reloaded on viewWillAppear.
features.entitlements: Configuration/Vime.entitlements, both App and extension in Debug and Release.

simulator.coverage: Seven feature tests plus existing sticky/alternate touch test and 70-key native input/prediction pipeline.

device.coverage: Soft-wrap navigation calculation and shared-view gesture, delete/undo/cancellation, panel layout/exit, height drag/shared preferences/extension controller reload.

validation.visual: Inspected local rendered delete callout, emoji panel and height preview. Images stay in /private/tmp; no test screenshot added to Git.
validation.sampling: One representative keyboard gap checked after resizing; no full keyboard grid or per-emoji tests repeated.

manual.reportedScenario: User confirmed vertical movement fails in automatically wrapped paragraphs without return characters.
manual.newBuildHostValidation: User confirmed features basically normal, then reported emoji bottom glass and inability to move back down. Follow-up Release fixed scroll-edge policies and retained per-gesture proxy text; user confirmed all three UI/navigation fixes normal, including no popup on ordinary delete.

followup.emojiRootCause: New collection/category scroll views omitted the four-edge hiding policy already used by candidate scroll views. Apply .never inset adjustment and hide all four scroll edge effects.
followup.cursorRootCause: Rebuilding proxy layout every movement loses traversed text if after-context is nil/truncated after an upward move. Keep text and caret position for the duration of each gesture, permitting a downward retrace.
followup.validation: Three targeted tests including existing warm performance benchmark passed on simulator and device. One additional simulator delete/undo test passed after restricting popup to upward gesture. Real extension manually confirmed by user.

limitations: Extension soft-wrap movement is approximate: public proxy APIs expose text context but not host font, input width or caret geometry. Host context truncation also affects row estimates.
Line-prefix deletion still uses explicit newline boundaries, up to 64 context chunks. It does not claim to delete only one visual soft-wrap row.
Height sharing requires full access. Other preferences remain separate in the App and extension.
Undo is intentionally one-step and only valid while the deletion anchor is unchanged; removed text is never persisted.
Shared-view/device unit tests do not prove exact row placement in every third-party App.
